114roce.title: SELECT v FROM Visit v JOIN FETCH v.pet p JOIN FETCH p.owner order by …

steps.text:
SELECT v1_0.id, v1_0.visit_date, v1_0.description, p1_0.id, p1_0.birth_date, p1_0.name, o1_0.id, o1_0.address, o1_0.city, o1_0.first_name, o1_0.last_name, o1_0.telephone, p1_0.type_id, v1_0.visit_time
FROM visits v1_0
JOIN pets p1_0
ON p1_0.id=v1_0.pet_id
JOIN owners o1_0
ON o1_0.id=p1_0.owner_id
ORDER BY v1_0.visit_date desc, v1_0.id
